title: [discussion] Parameters not rendering when feeding into `pyro.deterministic`
author: KevinTran-TRI

comments.author: BenZickel
comments.body:
Hi @KevinTran-TRI, the behavior you are seeing is a bug only in rendering the model's graph and will be fixed by #3378.

I'm not sure what you are trying to do but the computation is done correctly.

Please note however that [deterministic nodes are used mainly for recording values which are completely determined by their parents and they do not affect the model probability density](https://docs.pyro.ai/en/dev/primitives.html?highlight=deterministic#pyro.primitives.deterministic) and [cannot be observed](https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/issues/773).
